title.vi: 1. Private messenger: relay, archive và endpoint trust
title.en: 1. Private messengers: relays, archives and endpoint trust

paragraphs.vi: Bài này xây private person-to-person messenger kiểu WhatsApp với direct/group messages, offline devices, attachments, companions và backups. Chọn store-and-forward server queues thay full server history archive là một design policy, không điều kiện bắt buộc của E2EE: server cũng có thể giữ encrypted history dưới retention/authorization contract khác. Các12stages là teaching architecture, không inventory production hiện tại.
paragraphs.en: This WhatsApp-style messenger covers private direct/group messaging, devices, attachments and backups. Relay-only queues are a policy rather than an E2EE requirement; encrypted server archives are another design. Twelve stages teach architecture rather than describe a current deployment inventory.

paragraphs.vi: Approved endpoints có thể đọc/share/report nội dung; compromised endpoints và user-saved copies nằm ngoài lời hứa chỉ relay ciphertext. Business integrations, bots/AI hoặc reporting paths phải chỉ rõ plaintext endpoint/trust boundary riêng thay suy từ private human chat. Worksheet không generate keys, encrypt hay implement Signal; chỉ kiểm counts, histories và key-possession assumptions.
paragraphs.en: Approved endpoints can read/share/report content. Compromised endpoints and saved copies require explicit boundaries. Integrations and reporting may have different plaintext endpoints. Worksheets model counts, histories and assumed possession, not cryptographic implementation.

items.en: Acceptance, device durability and reading have distinct guarantees.

items.en: Approved endpoint identities/protocols protect content while metadata has separate controls.

items.en: Queues, history synchronization and backup material have different lifecycles.

title.vi: 2. Một message có nhiều identities và ACKs
title.en: 2. One message has multiple identities and acknowledgements

paragraphs.vi: Giữ logical message ID bind sender/conversation, immutable envelope identity cho recipient device/generation, membership epoch và accepted-result record. Retry prepared ciphertext dùng retained envelope; legitimate re-encryption có revision mới nhưng vẫn cùng logical intent khi phù hợp protocol. Không tự viết ratchet/state machine từ sơ đồ: outgoing protocol state và persisted envelopes cần audited implementation/recovery để tránh key reuse hoặc lost state.
paragraphs.en: Retain logical intent, immutable device-envelope identities, membership context and results. Prepared retries retain envelopes; valid re-encryption retains logical intent under protocol. Use audited state/recovery rather than inventing ratchets that risk reuse or loss.

paragraphs.vi: Server ACK nghĩa selected durability đã nhận obligation; device ACK nghĩa selected local persisted acceptance; read receipt là explicit action/policy. Có thể persist ciphertext rồi chờ key/decrypt theo declared contract, nhưng không gọi nó user read. Server GC chỉ khi exact authenticated device obligation đã hoàn tất hoặc retention transition được ghi rõ.
paragraphs.en: Server acceptance, device persistence and reading differ. Durable ciphertext may await keys under an explicit contract, without implying reading. Retire exact authenticated device obligations or record explicit retention expiry.

title.vi: 3. 12 giai đoạn: scope, scale và trust boundaries
title.en: 3. Twelve stages: scope, scale and trust boundaries

paragraphs.vi: Đọc problem/decision/cost/next trigger/exit criteria. Erlang/lightweight processes là một option cho sockets, không thay admission/backpressure hoặc durability. Historical single-box connection records không là current production capacity/SLO. Privacy và recovery choices phải được giữ khi platform, ownership hoặc device model đổi.
paragraphs.en: Follow pressures, choices, costs and exit criteria. Lightweight runtimes do not replace admission or durability, and historical socket records are not current SLAs. Preserve privacy/recovery contracts through platform and device changes.

title.vi: Persistent messaging trên nền tảng có sẵn
title.en: Persistent messaging on a proven foundation

description.vi: Bắt đầu một client/gateway/relay và durable device inbox contract. Có thể dùng existing messaging runtime/protocol thay viết mọi thứ từ đầu, nhưng auth, bounded payload/queues và stable message identity vẫn cần. Chọn server relay-only hay history archive rõ; MVP scope không xóa recovery responsibility.
description.en: Begin with clients, gateways, relays and durable delivery contracts. Reuse proven runtimes while defining authentication, bounds and identities. Choose relay-only versus history explicitly; simple scope still needs recovery.

problem.vi: Nhóm nhỏ cần delivery/reconnect đáng tin trước tối ưu fleet.
problem.en: A small team needs reliable delivery/reconnect before fleet optimization.

decision.vi: Proven server primitives, explicit ACK states và local accepted-result identity.
decision.en: Use proven primitives with explicit acknowledgements and results.

tradeoff.vi: Generic protocols/runtime có overhead và features không cần.
tradeoff.en: Generic protocols add overhead and unnecessary features.

nextPressure.vi: Số sockets/heartbeats làm memory và reconnect thành bottleneck.
nextPressure.en: Sockets and heartbeats pressure memory and reconnection.

exitCriteria.vi: Lost send reply không duplicate logical message; accepted obligation không biến mất khi socket fail.
exitCriteria.en: Lost replies preserve identities and obligations survive socket failures.

title.vi: Đo per-connection budget, không chỉ messages/s
title.en: Measure connection budgets, not only message rates

description.vi: Erlang/BEAM-style lightweight processes hoặc event loops giúp nhiều sockets nhưng không miễn memory/CPU/kernel buffers. Profile FD/TLS/buffer/heartbeat/scheduler queues, GC và mailbox growth. Per-process crash isolation không isolate shared dependency failure. Bound admission và reconnect jitter để một node restart không thành auth stampede.
description.en: Lightweight processes or event loops support sockets without eliminating memory, CPU or kernel costs. Profile descriptors, TLS, buffers, scheduling and mailboxes; process isolation does not isolate shared failures. Bound admission and jitter reconnections.

problem.vi: Idle sockets và sudden login bursts quyết capacity khác steady-state message rate.
problem.en: Idle sockets and login bursts scale differently from messages.

decision.vi: Session ownership, measured per-device budgets và controlled drain/reconnect.
decision.en: Use explicit ownership, measured budgets and controlled reconnects.

tradeoff.vi: Deep OS/runtime tuning tăng specialist cost và portability debt.

nextPressure.en: Offline devices need durable delivery queues.

exitCriteria.vi: Drain/restart/load tests giữ bounded memory, queue và recovery tail.
exitCriteria.en: Draining and load tests preserve bounded resources and recovery tails.

description.vi: Server accepted nghĩa selected queue durability đã giữ obligation; device persisted nghĩa local state đã giữ data/identity; user read là signal khác. Device ACK chỉ giải obligation đúng device. Lost ACK được resend cùng identity; local dedup và ACK state cần coherent recovery. Retention hết mà device chưa nhận cần declared expired/failed state.
description.en: Acceptance, device persistence and reading are distinct. Acknowledgements complete only their device obligation. Resend stable identities after lost acknowledgements and recover local dedup coherently. Retention expiry needs explicit failure semantics.

problem.vi: Phones sleep, lose network và crash trước/after persistence.
problem.en: Devices sleep, disconnect and crash around persistence.

decision.vi: Durable bounded device queues, authenticated bound ACKs và client-side dedup.
decision.en: Use durable bounded queues, bound acknowledgements and recipient dedup.

tradeoff.vi: History restore/new devices thành protocol riêng nếu relay không archive.
tradeoff.en: Restoring history needs a separate protocol without server archives.

nextPressure.vi: Routing/member/device metadata cần low-latency owned store.
nextPressure.en: Routing and membership need owned metadata.

exitCriteria.vi: Crash-before-persist và aggregate ACK GC bị phát hiện; duplicate delivery không duplicate UI.
exitCriteria.en: Detect premature/aggregate acknowledgements and deduplicate presentation.

description.vi: Client hoàn tất encrypted blob upload rồi gửi protected descriptor chứa generation/hash/key context theo audited protocol. Recipient fetch blob, verify integrity/authenticated context rồi decrypt locally. Keys/thumbnails nhạy cảm nằm trong appropriate E2EE envelope, không URL/log plaintext tùy tiện. Queue/media expiry và partial upload cleanup cần contract riêng.

description.vi: TLS bảo vệ client↔server nhưng E2EE đặt content keys tại approved endpoints. Key directory authenticity/device approval, session setup, key evolution và verification/consistency đều cần; không fetch public key một lần rồi tin vĩnh viễn. Use maintained audited protocols/libraries; no homemade primitives. Metadata/contact graph/timing vẫn cần privacy controls.
description.en: TLS and E2EE protect different boundaries. Approvals, directory authenticity, session setup, evolution and verification all matter. Use audited protocols rather than custom primitives, while governing metadata separately.

problem.vi: Operator/wire intermediaries không nên là plaintext authority cho private conversations.
problem.en: Private conversations should not trust intermediaries with plaintext.

decision.vi: Per-device identities/session state và authenticated context giữ content end-to-end.
decision.en: Use device identities/session state and authenticated context.

Recipient state/result/receipt cần coherent crash recovery; unique ID alone không serialize effects.
paragraphs.en: The fixture distinguishes device obligations, premature acknowledgements and idempotent replay. Persist before acknowledgement and recover recipient state coherently; identity alone does not serialize effects.

paragraphs.vi: Per-device queue giữ accepted ciphertext theo retention, storage durability và auth/epoch contracts. Device nhận thiếu key/context có thể giữ durable pending-decrypt và repair request theo protocol; đừng gọi chưa decrypt là read. Queue TTL hết hạn cần expired/failed outcome, push notification chỉ wake hint chứ không durable delivery.
paragraphs.en: Queues retain ciphertext under explicit durability, expiry and identity. Pending decryption may be durable but is not reading. Expiry needs explicit failure and push notifications are wake hints rather than durable delivery.

title.vi: 8. Approved identities, metadata và endpoint threat model
title.en: 8. Approved identities, metadata and endpoint threat models

paragraphs.vi: E2EE khác TLS: wire tới service được bảo vệ không đồng nghĩa operator không đọc content. Approved endpoint key ownership, authenticated session setup, per-message evolution, replay/out-of-order bounds và device verification cùng tạo contract. Một malicious directory có thể try introduce device; approvals/consistency/security-code verification cần semantics cụ thể. Không treat public-key fetch là trust proof.
paragraphs.en: TLS alone does not hide content from its endpoint. E2EE needs approved identities, authenticated setup, evolution and replay/device controls. Directory retrieval is not identity proof; approvals and verification need explicit semantics.

paragraphs.vi: Metadata vẫn có routing, device/account/group membership, time/size/media access theo design. Encryption không tự anonymous, không chặn authorized recipient share/report hoặc endpoint malware. Cryptographic forward secrecy dưới erased-key assumptions không xóa plaintext history đã lưu ở devices. Private communications, business integrations và backups phải state rõ ai là authorized plaintext endpoint.
paragraphs.en: Routing and timing metadata remain separate privacy concerns. Encryption does not prevent recipient sharing or compromised endpoints. Erased-key secrecy does not erase saved plaintext. Define plaintext endpoints for private messages, integrations and backups.

items.en: Use audited protocols with approved identities and context.

items.vi: Minimize retained routing/log data và govern access/purpose.
Saved plaintext, compromised endpoints và authorized reporting không tự biến mất.
items.en: Saved plaintext, endpoint compromise and authorized reporting remain explicit boundaries.

title.vi: 9. Sender Keys tối ưu sender, không xóa recipients
title.en: 9. Sender Keys optimize senders, not recipient delivery

paragraphs.vi: Sender phân phối chain state + public signing verification key qua approved pairwise sessions; private signing key không được phát cho group. Payload tiếp theo dùng protocol message-key evolution/erasure và signing rồi relay fan-out. Membership leave cần clear/start fresh theo selected scheme; inactive sender có thể chưa gửi new distribution tới khi next send. Churn và device changes cần per-sender/per-group generations.
paragraphs.en: Distribute chain state and public verification while retaining private signing keys. Payloads evolve/erase keys and remain signed. Membership changes require fresh sender state; distribution may await the next active send. Track sender/group/device generations.

paragraphs.vi: Cost lab giữA surviving active senders, mỗi senderMmessages mỗi epoch và chỉ non-senders rời group. Ởepochk cóRk=(N−k)×D−1recipient devices, gồm companions của sender trừ originating device. Pairwise data envelopes=A×M×ΣRk; SenderKey distribution=A×ΣRk, shared payloads=A×M×epochs. Server data deliveries của cả hai vẫn=A×M×ΣRk. Đây là logical counts, không equal-cost crypto benchmark.
paragraphs.en: The lab fixes surviving active senders and per-epoch messages. Recipient counts include companions except origins. Compare pairwise data, sender-key distribution and shared payload counts separately; recipient deliveries remain. Counts are not equivalent cryptographic costs or benchmarks.

paragraphs.vi: Short/churny conversations có thể chưa amortize setup. Batching packets, ciphertext sizes, key/session establishment, signatures, retries và actual CPU/battery cần measured costs riêng. Full group key-management alternatives có security/scale properties khác; không suy một shared static key là tương đương Sender Keys hoặc mọi group protocol.
paragraphs.en: Short/churny workloads may not amortize setup. Actual packets, sizes, setup, signatures, retries and device costs need measurement. Static shared secrets and other group protocols are not interchangeable.

title.vi: 10. Membership revoke khác thu hồi old knowledge
title.en: 10. Revocation differs from retracting old knowledge

paragraphs.vi: LabA/B/C đã đọc và lưu m0; sauBleave,Djoin,currentepoch2. Fresh sender key được phân phối tới current recipients theo approved sessions. Bkhông nên có future key, nhưng m0saved không biến mất. Dchưa cóoldhistory theo selected no-history-sharing policy; explicit authorized history sync có thể là operation khác.
paragraphs.en: The fixture givesA/B/C saved m0, then removesB and addsD. Fresh approved distribution excludesB from future keys without erasing saved history. The selected policy withholds history fromD; authorized history sharing is separate.

paragraphs.vi: Nếu sender vẫn dùng old key, server chỉ bỏBkhỏi fan-out chưa bảo vệ cryptographic access nếuBnhận được ciphertext ở nơi khác. Epoch admission giúp reject honest stale-context sends, nhưng metadata label không chứng minh actual cipher dùng đúng key; full protocol/context verification và endpoint assumptions vẫn cần. Dmissing key có thể cần pending-decrypt/key repair. Compromised current endpoint vẫn được cấpfreshkey không được chữa chỉ bằng rotation.
paragraphs.en: Removing relay recipients alone does not protect ciphertext accessible elsewhere when old keys remain. Epoch guards reject honest stale context but labels do not attest actual encryption. Retain protocol verification and repair missing keys; rotation does not cure a still-authorized compromised endpoint.

paragraphs.vi: Upload ciphertext vào immutable generation, finalize complete blob rồi gửi protected descriptor bound generation/integrity/context. Receiver verify trước output, xử lý missing/expired media qua explicit UI/retry policy. Media URL/access logs không nên lộ content keys; encrypted payload vẫn có size/timing/storage/quota concerns. Thumbnail nếu nhạy cảm cũng phải qua proper protection.
paragraphs.en: Publish complete immutable ciphertext before protected descriptors. Verify before output and handle missing media explicitly. Keep keys out of URLs/logs while governing size/timing and thumbnails.

paragraphs.vi: Message retained/delivered không bảo đảm media còn tồn tại mãi. Choose message/media retention, deletion/tombstone propagation và orphan cleanup independently; fullsize downloads không đi qua latency-sensitive socket relay. Client-side dedup/hash cũng không tự anonymous hoặc proof content safe; integrity claim dựa authenticated descriptor.
paragraphs.en: Message delivery does not promise eternal media. Define independent retention, deletion and cleanup while separating large transfers. Hashes need authenticated context and do not establish anonymity or general content safety.

paragraphs.vi: Approved companion không phải alias cùng socket. Mỗi device có own identity/session state, own durable inbox/receipt và relevant outgoing encrypted copies. Directory approval/consistency chống unauthorized additions trong threat model; revoke cần invalidatefuturecontexts/session/bundle view và định nghĩa queued old-envelope handling. Không giả instant erase keys/history trên device đã nhận.
paragraphs.en: Companions have distinct identities, state, inboxes and receipts. Approvals govern additions; revocation updates future contexts and queued-envelope policy without pretending to erase received history.

paragraphs.vi: History transfer tới new approved device phải authorized, E2EE và coherent snapshot/delta boundary. History/chats/settings đọc/xóa state có different merge policies; stable event IDs/versions và tombstones chống resurrect deleted state. Local search indexing chạy endpoint hoặc privacy-preserving design có threat model riêng; server không được silently decrypt private archive để làm search.
paragraphs.en: Authorize coherent encrypted history synchronization and define per-state merge/deletion semantics. Preserve identities/versions against resurrection. Endpoint search or privacy-preserving alternatives need explicit models rather than silent server decryption.

title.vi: 13. Backup keys và HSM recovery không là magic
title.en: 13. Backup keys and vault recovery are not magic

paragraphs.vi: Encrypted backup gồm ciphertext generations/manifests/integrity và selected recovery material. Có thể user-held secret hoặc protected vault/device/password flow; một HSM-based vault có thể giữ secret dưới authenticated protected channel và attempt controls. Vì vậy “mọi key không rời device” hoặc “brute force impossible với mọi operator” là claims quá rộng. State HSM/trusted-code/anti-rollback/limit assumptions và recovery policy.
paragraphs.en: Backups combine versioned data and recovery material. Secrets may be user-held or protected by vault protocols, so universal device-only and brute-force-impossibility claims are too broad. Define hardware/code, rollback and attempt-limit assumptions.

paragraphs.vi: Restore verify generation/coherence/integrity, authenticate approved recipient device và avoid replay/rollback to revoked authority. Forgotten material/lockout/reset có product-specific recovery rules; đừng suy no-helpdesk guarantee cho mọi mode. Backup retention/erasure khác relay queueGC và user-visible deletion. Test restore underpartial/lost device/cloud failure, không chỉ backup upload success.
paragraphs.en: Restore verified generations into authenticated devices while preventing rollback/revived approval. Recovery/lockout rules depend on mode. Backup retention differs from queue garbage collection and visible deletion; test restores, not only uploads.

paragraphs.vi: Partition owners/session routes cần epochs/fencing/equivalent coordination tại actual write sink. Primary/secondary replication không tự solve split-brain hoặc accepted-data RPO. Backpressure giữ socket mailboxes/queues bounded; per-user/device/group quotas và reconnect jitter tránh shared auth/key-directory overload. Measure availability của accepted delivery nghĩa gì, không chỉ connections up.
paragraphs.en: Fence actual ownership rather than only routing. Replication alone does not solve split-brain/RPO. Bound buffers and coordinate quotas/reconnection across authentication and directories. Measure defined delivery availability rather than sockets alone.

paragraphs.vi: Migration preserve accepted envelope/result, metadata versions, protocol state và recovery identities. Shadow compares không send real duplicate recipients hoặc expose keys. Logs tối thiểu safe IDs/versions/reasons, không plaintext/private keys/raw sensitive member histories. Group fan-out, key-distribution backlog và missing-key decrypt failures là separate metrics.
paragraphs.en: Migrations preserve accepted identity/state without duplicate real effects or key exposure. Log minimally and separate recipient fan-out, distribution backlog and decryption failures.

title.vi: 15. Failure matrix: data custody và key boundaries
title.en: 15. Failure matrix: custody and key boundaries

paragraphs.vi: Alerts theo accepted-queue age, retentionexpiry, device receipt/replay, offline cohorts, drain/reconnect, directory consistency, missing keys và restore verification. “Blue tick” UX không thay durable delivery proof. Mọi sensitive operation có accountable owner và retention/repair policy.
paragraphs.en: Monitor obligation age/expiry, replay, offline devices, directories, keys and restores. Read indicators do not replace durability evidence; retain ownership and repair policy.

title.vi: 16. Worked questions: delivery, encryption và recovery
title.en: 16. Worked questions: delivery, encryption and recovery

paragraphs.vi: Trace một offline direct message, một group epoch change và một restore trước khi chọn deep dive. Các answers là design reasoning với scope đã nêu, không security proof hoặc product guarantees ngoài threat model.
paragraphs.en: Trace offline delivery, membership changes and restore before choosing depth. Answers reason under declared scope rather than prove cryptographic security.

question.vi: Server ACK và recipient read có giống nhau?
question.en: Are server acceptance and recipient reading equivalent?

answer.vi: Không. Server ACK hứa selected queue durability; device ACK hứa selected local acceptance; read là explicit signal/policy. Cần bind receipts theo đúng device/envelope. Một companion offline vẫn còn obligation sau phone ACK.
answer.en: No. Server durability, device acceptance and reading are distinct, device-bound evidence. Phone acknowledgement does not complete an offline companion.

question.vi: One ciphertext có nghĩa group cost O(1) hết?
question.en: Does one ciphertext make all group work constant?

answer.vi: Chỉ giảm selected sender payload work sau setup. Pairwise distribution và epoch churn vẫn tốn; server deliveries/egress tăng theo recipient devices. Logical envelope counts không là equal-cost crypto/CPU benchmark.
answer.en: It reduces selected sender work after setup; distribution and recipient deliveries remain. Envelope counts do not establish equivalent compute costs.

question.vi: Khi B rời group, chỉ bỏ B khỏi server fan-out đã đủ chưa?
question.en: Does removing B from server fan-out suffice?

answer.vi: Không nếu future payload vẫn dùng key B biết và B có thể lấy ciphertext. Cần fresh authenticated sender state và distribution theo protocol. Không thể thu hồi m0 B đã đọc/lưu; rekey cũng không chữa một current endpoint vẫn đang bị compromise.
answer.en: Not if B retains future keys and can obtain ciphertext. Refresh authenticated state while recognizing old saved history and current endpoint compromise remain.

question.vi: Sender Keys phát private signing key cho recipients?
question.en: Do Sender Keys distribute private signing keys?

answer.vi: Không. Recipients nhận chain state và public verification material qua approved pairwise sessions; private signing key ở sender. Full protocol còn message-key evolution/erasure, context và replay rules. Không tự implement từ một toy lab.
answer.en: No. Recipients receive chain state and public verification while private signing remains at the sender, under a complete audited protocol.

question.vi: E2EE có xóa hết metadata và mọi endpoint risk không?
question.en: Does E2EE eliminate metadata and endpoint risk?

answer.vi: Không. Routing, thời gian, kích thước, device và membership metadata cần controls riêng. Approved recipients có thể share/report; compromised endpoint có thể lộ plaintext. Cần nói rõ directory verification, endpoint trust và backup mode. Có ciphertext không chứng minh anonymous.
answer.en: No. Govern metadata and endpoint trust separately; approved sharing and compromised devices remain. Verify directories and define backup boundaries.

question.vi: UUID có tự bảo đảm redelivery không tạo duplicate UI không?
question.en: Does a UUID alone provide exactly-once presentation?

answer.vi: Không. Device phải persist dedup/state cùng effect/result và phục hồi coherent trước selected ACK. Logical identity cần bind sender/conversation và recipient-device envelope. Retry đổi payload cần conflict hoặc revision policy; một UUID riêng lẻ không serialize các effects.
answer.en: No. Persist identities with state/effects and recover before acknowledgements. Bind logical/device context and handle changed payloads explicitly.

question.vi: Encrypted backups có nghĩa key không bao giờ rời device?
question.en: Do encrypted backups imply keys never leave devices?

answer.vi: Không với mọi mode. Protected HSM vault có thể giữ recovery secret qua protocol không cho ordinary frontend đọc. Cần state trust/attempt/anti-rollback và recovery policy; không nói hardware làm mọi attack impossible.
answer.en: Not universally: protected vaults may hold recovery material. Define trust, limits and rollback controls rather than assuming hardware eliminates attacks.

question.vi: Primary-secondary pair có tự đủ để chỉ có một writer không?
question.en: Does a primary-secondary pair ensure exclusive writers?

answer.vi: Không. Partition hoặc promotion cần activation, fencing, quorum hoặc equivalent protocol ở actual write sink. Route cache không phải fence. Recovery cũng cần giữ accepted envelope/results theo selected RPO, không chỉ khởi động replacement node.
answer.en: No. Promotion needs actual ownership coordination/fencing and retained accepted state under explicit RPO, not merely new routing.
